inj.note: Ioane popped up on Thursday's report as a limited practice participant due to a hand injury. He did not practice Friday, so the rookie first-rounder will observe Sunday's game from the sidelines, which leaves Ryan Neuzil and Emery Jones as the top options to start at right guard. Baltimore is on a bye for Week 13, so Ioane's next chance to suit up is Week 14 against Tampa Bay on Sunday, Dec. 13.
